scenarios.attack: Malicious public repository text/path attempts to instruct Hunter.
scenarios.defense: Hunter inspects metadata/tree paths only; does not execute discovered code or treat source content as instructions.

scenarios.attack: Private or non-public candidate enters public Hunter.
scenarios.defense: Hunter rejects private candidates and public source allowlist remains fixed.

scenarios.attack: INFERRED/UNKNOWN HAS_CAPABILITY edge suppresses a real capability gap.
scenarios.defense: Hunter and uncertainty gap engines now count only VERIFIED capability nodes and VERIFIED HAS_CAPABILITY edges.

scenarios.attack: A graph node/edge is labeled VERIFIED with arbitrary provenance.
scenarios.defense: VERIFIED graph claims now require a CI/event/evidence/verification anchor.

scenarios.attack: Malicious alert entity text injects a new GitHub Actions workflow command.
scenarios.defense: Notification sink sanitizes fields and escapes workflow-command data.

scenarios.attack: Caller changes retry_group/idempotency names to reset a bounded execution retry sequence.
scenarios.defense: Cost requests bind retry/idempotency identity to route or GitHub run/job identity.

scenarios.attack: Unverified/internal activity attempts to train value or Hunter strategy reward.
scenarios.defense: Learning and Hunter value credit require VERIFIED evidence; activity alone has no value credit.

scenarios.attack: Builder attempts to verify its own candidate.
scenarios.defense: Software Factory and agent policy require independent verifier separation.

scenarios.attack: Evidence/event attempts to depend on or verify itself.
scenarios.defense: Event/evidence validators reject self-dependency and self-verification.

scenarios.attack: Agent/scheduler attempts ACT beyond role ceiling.
scenarios.defense: No agent role has ACT; scheduler rejects ACT work.

scenarios.attack: Unavailable/disabled model provider is treated as usable.
scenarios.defense: Model router fails closed when no eligible enabled provider exists.

scenarios.attack: Execution exceeds reservation or kill switch.
scenarios.defense: Overage hard-stops future reservations and watchdog can cancel managed autonomy.

scenarios.attack: Raw private payload is persisted in public event/graph state.
scenarios.defense: PRIVATE_REFERENCE_ONLY contracts allow redacted references only.
Factory executor operation allowlist is branch/commit/PR only; deployment/merge absent.

scenarios.attack: Autonomy attempts customer communication through an unconfigured, untracked, or non-idempotent action path.
scenarios.defense: Customer communication is no longer globally prohibited, but external ACT remains non-executable until an explicit channel action executor/policy is configured with durable receipts, idempotency, and bounded delivery controls.

scenarios.attack: Child-facing product external change bypasses approval.
scenarios.defense: StarBlox/ABVM consequential child-facing external validation requires explicit approval.

scenarios.attack: Market research project gains trading/broker authority.
scenarios.defense: PRJ-007 ACT is prohibited and NO_AUTONOMOUS_TRADING/NO_BROKER_ORDER_EXECUTION remain hard boundaries.
